Installation and operation

The App includes installation and process management. Desktop components are downloaded on first installation. Install original QQ separately below. Deploy other programs manually using their official documentation; compatibility depends on each program.

Original QQ and NapCat keep separate data. Starting original QQ stops NapCat; starting NapCat stops original QQ. The desktop itself can coexist with bot services.

Start the desktop in the App, then paste and run the environment configuration in Terminal to launch graphical programs. Installation also provides desktop-start and qq-desktop; manually launched processes belong to their terminal session.

Download a lightweight desktop, noVNC, fonts and dependencies, adding about 230 MiB depending on installed packages. Services, SSH, cpolar and terminal sessions stop during installation. Previously running services restart afterwards; reopen Terminal manually. Continue?
Download about 196 MiB from Tencent, verify and extract it. Installed size is about 640 MiB. NapCat files are preserved. Continue?
Stop NapCat and start independent original QQ? Both data directories are preserved. Restart NapCat from Home to switch back.
Stop desktop and QQ, remove independent QQ binaries and extension installation markers. QQ login data and shared Ubuntu dependencies are preserved. Uninstall?
